english.meaning: to think something that turns out to be wrong
english.note: 以為 X means you thought X, but you were mistaken.

exampleSentences.english: I thought you were looking for me, but it was Ah Wai.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我以為你揾我，原來係阿慧揾我。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 wai4 nei5 wan2 ngo5 jyun4 loi4 hai6 aa3 wai6 wan2 ngo5

exampleSentences.english: Really? I thought only women did that.
exampleSentences.traditional: 係呀？哦，我以為淨係女人先會噉。
